Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Andrei Svislotskiy was older than Fred Williamson based on the comparison of birth years. While the birth years were correctly retrieved (1938 for Fred Williamson and 1960 for Andrei Svislotskiy), the Planner erroneously stated that "1960 is greater than 1938, Andrei Svislotskiy is older by 22 years." This is a fundamental logical error in comparing birth years, as a smaller birth year (1938) indicates an older individual. This mistake directly led to the incorrect solution being presented, despite accurate data being gathered by the WebSurfer.
